meta.title: Avtoskop — describe the car, sellers will offer options
meta.description: Post a request for a car — importers, dealers and owners send offers. Your number stays hidden until you decide.

home.title: Describe the car — sellers will offer options
home.lead: Importers, dealers and owners send offers for your request. You compare them with the market and decide who gets your number.
home.sources: Listings from AUTO.RIA, OLX and dealers — in one search
home.cardTitle: Which car are you looking for?
home.cardSubtitle: Sellers will send offers for your request
home.cardNote: Free. Your number is hidden from sellers
home.step1Text: Model, years, budget and region. Two minutes.
home.step2Text: Importers, dealers and owners offer options.
home.step3Text: Only sellers you choose see your number.
home.trust1Text: Sellers don't call without your consent
home.trust3Text: Every offer is compared with the market

request.privacy: Your number is hidden. You share it only with sellers you choose.

sellers.title: Buyers have already described what they want. Offer your car
sellers.lead: Avtoskop collects requests from people ready to buy: model, years, budget, region. You browse the requests and send an offer — no cold calls, no paid ads.
sellers.activeCount: {count, plural, =0 {No active requests yet} one {# active request} other {# active requests}} right now
sellers.step1Text: Filter by make, region and import. No sign-up needed to browse.
sellers.step2Text: Car, all-in price, timing, photos. One offer from you per request.
sellers.step3Text: If your offer fits, the buyer shares their number with you.
sellers.whoImportersText: Cars from the US, Europe and Korea for a specific request
sellers.whoDealersText: New and used cars from your stock
sellers.whoBuyoutText: Cars you've already bought and are preparing to sell
sellers.whoOwnersText: Selling your car — find someone looking for exactly that
sellers.rule1: Only real cars with a real all-in price
sellers.rule2: One offer per request — no spam or duplicates
sellers.rule3: Buyer contacts only with the buyer's consent
sellers.rule4: Phone check for everyone, plus registration details for companies
sellers.rule5: After a deal the buyer rates the seller; ratings are public
sellers.priceText: Free during the pilot. Later you'll pay only when a buyer has chosen to share their number with you.
sellers.telegramText: Soon: a bot will send you requests for your makes and regions.
sellers.signInLink: Sign in or create a seller profile

board.lead: People looking for a car right now. Contacts are hidden: send an offer and the buyer decides who gets their number.

auth.title: Seller sign-in
auth.lead: Sign in with Telegram to send offers to buyers. Telegram confirms your phone number — no SMS, no passwords.
auth.step1: Open the Avtoskop bot in Telegram
auth.step2: Tap Start, then Share my number
auth.step3: Come back here — sign-in completes automatically
auth.expired: The link has expired. Please try again.
auth.privacy: Buyers don't see your number. We use it only for verification and to contact you.
auth.notConfigured: Telegram sign-in isn't set up yet: add TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME to .env and start the bot (pnpm bot).
auth.devLogin: Sign in as a test seller (local only)
